label: sparse conjunctive context feature: tokens 2/f/a/3/l/t at original positions 3-5 after first token j/1/2/h/i
explanation: Very sparse (0.027% of steps). Never fires at t=0-2 or on the last copy steps. About 60% of mass is in the original phase at positions 3-5, enriched for input tokens 2, f, a, 3, l, t, h, o, for previous tokens v, w, s, and for first tokens j (10x lift), 1, 2, h, i. The other ~40% is in the copy phase, mostly when the input is 2 (copied back) at early recall indices. The best predicate (input-token set x first-token set x position 3-5) gets about 45% recall but only about 1.4% precision. Adding a copy-phase clause for input 2 raises recall to about 56% but not precision. Adding prev-token and seen() conditions did not help. The feature looks like a specific conjunction of hidden-state contributions from several earlier tokens, and simple predicates cannot capture it. Activations are fairly uniform (median 0.116, max 0.222). Not checked what modulates magnitude.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=2 (+5.03), t=3 & prev_tok=w (+4.41), orig0=j (+3.93), phase=2 & in_tok=h (+3.66), orig0=1 (+3.21), in_tok=f (+3.21). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-4.09), orig3=p (-2.92), orig3=u (-2.72), prev3_tok=1 (-2.55).
